'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Travis Cooper LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Travis Cooper]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Charlie in the CC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
